response.answer: The absolute-dollar primary label mix with percent and tangible-action alternatives yields the best net welfare versus regressivity across income deciles and price-sensitivity segments. This approach balances fairness and clarity for diverse consumer segments.

results.title: Arbitration Agreements - Federal Register
results.content: The Study included extensive research into this subject, including an analysis of public enforcement actions filed over a period of five years by State and Federal regulators and the relationship, or lack of relationship of these cases to private class litigation.[147]  Commenters also recommended that the Bureau study whether arbitration reduces companies' dispute resolution costs and the relationship between any such cost savings and the cost and availability of consumer financial products and services.
